shared_elements: frontal/upright anthropomorphic body with head, torso and legs
justification: The only correspondence is that both depict upright human figures, which is a near-universal motif; A shows a single elaborately costumed personage with headdress, beaded ornaments, layered garments and held objects rendered in fine detailed outline, while B shows two featureless silhouette stick-figures standing on a boat with upturned prow and stern. There is no shared relationship, arrangement or drawing convention: one is dense, detailed and single-figure, the other is minimal, solid-filled and composed as a crew-in-vessel scene.
